# @k8ordo/ui

> React components from k8ordo, with semantic design tokens, dark mode,
> built-in wording that follows `@k8ordo/i18n` (Japanese and English included), AI chat components, and official generative UI
> adapters (json-render & OpenUI) that let an LLM generate, validate, and render
> on-brand UIs from these components.
>
> Like every k8ordo package it assumes React 19 and Server Components, uses only
> what has reached Baseline, and ships no polyfills or legacy fallbacks — so
> nothing here branches for a browser or a framework it does not support.

When installed via npm, these docs live under `node_modules/@k8ordo/ui/docs/`.
Start with GUIDE.md, then follow the reference most relevant to the task.

## Guide

- [Design Guide](GUIDE.md): setup, dark mode (the `dark` class that `@k8ordo/color-scheme` puts on `<html>`, and the `color-scheme` the stylesheet sets to match), i18n (wording in `@k8ordo/i18n`'s current locale, English without a locale set, registering other locales, migrating from `UIProvider`'s `messages`), design direction, aesthetic guidelines, component usage principles, anti-patterns, implementation principles, testing (component tests belong in a real browser — Vitest browser mode or Playwright — because the components call browser APIs jsdom does not implement).

## References

- [Components](references/components.md): full component list, import paths, props, and i18n — every component, compound ones included (`Dialog.Root`, `Tabs.Root`, …), renders from a Server Component — component wording comes from the dictionary of `@k8ordo/i18n`'s current locale (English when the app defines no locale set); `@k8ordo/ui/i18n` exports `ja` / `en` / the `Messages` type, `registerMessages(locale, messages)` for any other locale or a replacement (per-component wording props win over any dictionary), and `getMessages()` — not a hook — to read the wording in effect in your own elements.
- [AI chat](references/ai-chat.md): AI chat components from `@k8ordo/ui/ai` (Conversation / Message / PromptInput / Reasoning / Suggestion / ToolInvocation), streaming Markdown `Response` from `@k8ordo/ui/ai/response` (optional peer `streamdown`), and `mapMessageParts` from `@k8ordo/ui/ai-sdk` to render AI SDK `UIMessage.parts` (optional peer `ai`).
- [Generative UI](references/generative-ui.md): use json-render / OpenUI to make an LLM generate UIs — `catalog.prompt()` (server-safe), `<JsonRenderUI spec={spec} />` (client), `validateGeneratedSpec()` (validate/repair LLM output), `satisfies UISpec` (typed specs), `@k8ordo/ui/openui/prompt`, and which exports the catalog leaves out on purpose.
- [Typography](references/typography.md): type scale and usage.
- [Color](references/color.md): semantic token system and dark mode.
- [Spacing & layout](references/spatial-design.md): spacing scale and layout patterns.
- [Interaction](references/interaction-design.md): motion and interaction guidelines.
- [Types](references/types.md): the shared types for typing component props (`Status` / `Direction` / `Placement` / `ModalSide` / `DrawerSide` / `Option`).

## Data exports

- `@k8ordo/ui/tokens`: the design tokens resolved to JS values — `tokens` (`theme` / `vars` / `refs`), `meta`, and key unions such as `ColorToken`.
- `@k8ordo/ui/props.json`: every component's props as JSON (`docs/props.generated.json`), generated from the types — the same data as the Props blocks in components.md.
